subject: Status advisory — elevated tail latency & partial 5xxs in hosted inference (RadarWorks)
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@radarworks.com>, ops@radarworks.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Status advisory — elevated tail latency & partial 5xxs in hosted inference (RadarWorks)

Hi Liam / RadarWorks ops team,

We're sending a quick advisory: from ~07:58–08:12 PST this morning we observed an increase in p95/p99 tail latency for generation requests and a small spike in 502/503 errors for hosted inference in the us-west1 region that may have impacted some of your customer-facing calls. Our monitoring alerted at 07:59 and we immediately opened an incident (INF-9482).

What we've done so far:
- Activated incident runbook and paged SRE/Oncall.
- Scoped the impact to generation endpoints routed via route-proxy v2 (internal routing component).
- Temporarily disabled an internal routing experiment and scaled the fallback pool to absorb traffic.

Immediate status: mitigation applied; we are continuing to monitor for recurrence. At the moment the majority of traffic is returning to baseline, but we wanted to notify you proactively so you have visibility and can triage on your side if you saw errors.

Attachments: pprof snapshot and bridgelog are attached for your ops team to inspect.

Ask: can you confirm whether you saw customer-facing errors for more than a few minutes or any downstream alerts we should correlate? If you'd like, we can open a joint bridge.

We'll follow up with an incident update within 90 minutes and a postmortem within 72 hours.

Apologies for the disruption — we'll keep you updated.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Technical Account Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Status advisory — elevated tail latency & partial 5xxs in hosted inference (RadarWorks)

Naomi — quick internal note: Oncall has pulled a heap/pprof and is seeing steady growth of resident memory in route-proxy v2 under sustained small-batch workloads. Evictions are triggering longer tails and a handful of request failures when the proxy misses the fallback path.

Mitigation timeline: disabled experiment at 08:05 PST, scaled fallback pool +30% at 08:10 PST. Error rates tapered off by ~08:55 PST. We're starting a hotfix branch to add a defensive cap and will run a rollback test to confirm.

I'll coordinate a short RCA and draft an initial timeline for the postmortem. Recommend we offer RadarWorks a short usage credit for the window and flag this incident for SLA review.

—Marissa
Engineering Operations
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@radarworks.com>, ops@radarworks.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Update: mitigations applied — monitoring continuing (RadarWorks)

Hi Liam, thanks for the quick reply — wanted to share an update from the team: 

Summary:
- Root symptom: memory growth in route-proxy v2 under certain prefix-caching patterns causing connection slowdowns and occasional 502/503 surface errors.
- Mitigation: disabled routing experiment and scaled fallback pool; observed error rate return to baseline by 08:55 PST.

Impact: We estimate the window of meaningful customer impact was ~07:58–08:55 PST; internal telemetry shows ~0.6% of generation requests returned 5xx during that window across the impacted region. We are not seeing related errors in dedicated/reserved clusters — impact appears scoped to hosted routing path.

Next steps:
- Deploy a hotfix to add a defensive cap and memory guard in route-proxy v2 (ETA: 48 hours, currently in hotfix branch).
- Run a controlled rollback of the routing experiment and validate with synthetic traffic.
- Postmortem and customer-facing RCA within 72 hours.

Attachments: incident snapshot + bridgelog attached. We will also publish a brief status page update: https://status.redwood.com/incident/2026-11-17/INF-9482

If RadarWorks would like a 1:1 bridge to walk through the logs and impact, we're available this afternoon.

Best,
Naomi
Sr. Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference

Quick Qs:
- Did this affect customers on Dedicated nodes or only hosted? (We saw one alert spike in our synthetic checks hitting hosted endpoints.)
- Any immediate ETA for a permanent fix beyond the hotfix branch?

Would like to join a bridge if you spin one up. Also please include estimated customer credit details in the postmortem — our finance team will likely request a filer for that window.

—Liam
